scope: Local research only; no production/SDK/champion/live changes, no network or paid models; no pushes or deployment after tournament cutoff

calibration.simple_profiles: silent; first offered legal action or uniform legal action using the Game-assigned independent seat RNG; including offered abstention
calibration.runtime_control: All controlled profiles retain ContestantSeat scheduling identity; other six seats and initial RNG streams identical

loss_selection.order: Within each role/background sort bySHA256('ww-causal-loss-v1:'+scenarioID), then round-robin through fixed B0 background order until100perrole; record exhausted/absent strata
loss_selection.sample_note: Role-balanced, loss-conditioned diagnosis, not the natural4:1role mix and not win-rate confirmation

interventions.scope: Moving actions only: every offered day vote and seer investigation in each selected baseline loss, exactly one action override per branch
interventions.limit: 30controlled decisions per game; game action_trace bound100 retained
interventions.branch: Replay the entire game from the same deal and all initial per-seat RNG streams, compute B0 at the intervention then replace only its emitted legal action; all future policies execute normally and see actual resulting state
interventions.prefix_check: SHA256chain of all action/chat callback inputs and outputs must match until intervention; actor raw state and proposed action must also match
interventions.noop_check: Original action replays at every point must reproduce full terminal trace and outcome exactly
interventions.rng_note: One seeded continuation per action; future RNG consumption can naturally diverge after the action. This is a diagnostic conditional outcome, not an estimate of general action value.
interventions.information_boundary: Evaluator prefix hashes/full roles/future outcomes never enter actor inputs. Saved actor inputs contain only its actual raw view and Werewolf match memory after B0 computes its proposal, before any overridden action affects the game. B0 voting/investigation selectors do not store an action-dependent choice; replay reconstruction is checked. No privileged features for policies.

metrics: fraction of selected losses with at least one winning single-action continuation

all legal branches retained; violations of private known-wolf/known-clear or unread-investigation preference flagged and excluded from unchanged-guard candidate examples, not declared mathematically suboptimal
publicly identical view groups with conflicting hindsight-best actions
interpretation: Best-of-many hindsight branching is optimistic selection within fixed hidden worlds. No rescue does not prove the loss unavoidable (speech and multiple interventions not searched). A rescue does not prove the player could infer the action. No learned strategy or upgrade is claimed from this dataset alone.
next_gate: Only construct a rule if supported by a permitted-information mechanism; evaluate wins as well as losses on new development data. Holdouts39701/39702 and independent opponent-family tests remain reserved; existing2pp/nonregression requirements unchanged.

resources.raw: bounded compressed evaluator-only records; no deployment decision recording
